svg.title: For the determinant assertion, use its continuity and its value one on the compact ball; outside the ball it is exactly one. The derivative bound makes pM Lipschitz with constant 1/2. Thus ΦM is injective, since equality of two images implies ∥a −b∥≤1 2∥a −b∥, and surjective, since for each target b the contraction a 7→b−pM(a) has a fixed point. Its derivative is invertible by the Neumann series. Consequently it is a global smooth change of real coordinates with positive Jacobian jM. For an original coarse background V0 and a nearby background V , the correction at a fine link is Me = (replica V0)e(replica V )−1 e , u′ e = ΦMe(ue). (PV3)
